$comment: Gate registry — ARCHITECTURE.md §7. Every executable gate (class A and B) is registered before the project relies on it, then changes activation state as the milestone advances. Class-C evidence (peer review, sign-off) is deliberately absent: it lives in the phase-exit checklist, not in a runner.
$comment-selects: A gate whose runner is a vitest path filter carries `selects`: the exact spec files that filter must resolve to, `[]` while the gate's specs have not landed yet. Two defects made this necessary. First, every filter gate was registered as `pnpm test -- <pattern>`; under pnpm 10 that separator is consumed and the pattern never reaches vitest, so each ran the entire suite and passed while claiming to prove one specific thing. Second, once the form is corrected, a filter can still resolve to the WRONG files and pass green - `pnpm test corpus` selects only the two corpus-pin reader specs, none of the conformance suites the gate describes. test/gates/gate-selection.spec.ts pins every filter's resolution, so adding, renaming or moving a spec fails loudly instead of silently changing what a gate covers.

gates.description: dependency-cruiser: the eight layering rules of §3, plus the render kind inventory
Node-only Vitest suite, including the pegkit conformance suite
Built ESM/CJS loads for every published code entry, exact exports for format entries, and forbidden-layer checks for configured non-root entries, including HTML, plus publint; only attw runs npm pack
Valid structural objects render; unknown kinds and non-node inputs raise RenderError
Deferred-construct text fallback, diagnostics, dedup, and original-input offsets

gates.run: pnpm test corpus- model-parity render-parity degenerate-slots asciimath/grammar
gates.description: For each format selected by this gate, every corpus case has a pinned outcome: exact Ruby-generated bytes where implemented, and an explicit refusal or named divergence everywhere else. For html the degenerate-slot sweep adds every landed HTML renderer the corpus never reaches: its swept set is derived from the src/render inventory, and a renderer nothing sweeps is a failure
Generated source tables match their recorded inputs; managed renderer fixtures have paired sidecars, validated provenance and payload hashes; every covered artifact declares itself committable
Inputs the gem rejects are rejected here
Behavioural probe matrix for context-dependent symbols

Deep nesting, unmatched fences and long token runs reach a pinned clean outcome - a parse or a typed error, never an untyped throw - within a measured time ceiling. A true non-returning loop is NOT bounded here: the check is synchronous, so only a job timeout catches one
Ruby-backed unit regressions for the oracle runner and fixture-provenance normalizer, run with a pinned Ruby interpreter
Regenerate this repository's generated data from a clean gem checkout; diff must be empty
Regenerate the pinned plurimath-testsuite corpus from the same clean gem checkout; diff must be empty
Seeded bounded input generator compared live against the gem
